speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Six horses, Master Shakespeare, and a pair of hose from your mother. Thick knitted worsted. They have had a dryish ride of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hose stay with me. I am not sending them back the day they come. I have four lines for you, and twopence.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence the letter. Tell me the sense, in case the paper takes wet between here and the bridge. I can carry a letter. I cannot invent a day that is not written.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I leave London on Wednesday the twenty-sixth, by Oxford. I look to be at the bridge on Friday by dusk. You leave Saturday, so you are there two days before me. The money I bring myself.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then they'll have time to sweep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sweep is for the house. It is not a fifth line. The four are the day, the road, his Saturday, and the money in my hand.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I came round from St Bride's with a paper of pins for our mother. They can go with the letter. I am not making a parcel out of a paper.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A paper is not a parcel. Twopence covers the letter. I will not take sixpence for pins that weigh less than the seal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence, then. Nothing beside it. Here.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Other quarters I have carried the Lady Day money. It would be safer in my pack than on that bay of the Bull's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it'll be safe twice. Sixty shillings, sewn in the canvas, and they stay with me. You do not get them.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The Oxford way is drying nicely in this wind. Foul in the bottoms beyond Wycombe. The river is up at Shipston.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twelve hours to Wycombe at my pace.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At mine?

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: On that bay? Nine, and he'll argue every mile.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then you will have a companion who answers. The pins are still a paper, Hobbins. Not a pocket with a price on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four lines is what I am sending. The long letter is still on the board at home. It has no day in it. This one has.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I leave Saturday. I will be at the bridge before you, if the bottoms allow it. I am not carrying the canvas. You have said so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Said once is the whole of it. The hose come home with me.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: She sent them to be worn. She will see them when you do, not from a London yard.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Done. Six horses, one letter, a paper of pins, and no canvas. Twopence is in my hand. God keep you both.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. The bridge on Friday by dusk, and not a word more than the four lines.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I will not add the sweep to the paper after you have sealed it. Time to sweep was my saying, not an instruction to her.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I heard it as a saying. I am not writing it in under your seal. The road is mine to judge, and I have judged it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve hours at your pace, nine at mine, and he will argue. I have that.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Wycombe, the bottoms, Shipston. That is the road I will swear to. I am not selling you a sixth town for the pleasure of it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then we are done before the yard makes it a dinner. The pins, Hobbins. Flat, and with the letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Flat. Twopence. No canvas. The hose are coming home with me, and the sixty shillings are not.
